composition_subtypes.role: Generate all subsets of factorials (3!..14!), precompute sum and count.
Use popcount to represent remainder as sum of distinct powers of two.

payload.core_composition_summary: Brute-force over factorial subsets, then use popcount for power-of-two decomposition of remainder to minimize total count.
payload.rationale: Solution combines complete subset search for factorials with bit-counting for powers of two, both necessary to achieve minimal representation.
